overview.text: Museum devoted to science, nature, art and other subjects via hands-on exhibits.

text.text: People say this children's museum offers a wide variety of hands-on activities, including a grocery store, farm, water games, and an outdoor play area with bikes and a course. They highlight the fair price, the clean and well-maintained facilities, and the fun and imaginative experiences for children of all ages. They also like the friendly, helpful, and attentive staff.

displayName.text: Washington State Capitol Building and Campus

overview.text: Expansive state park featuring a boardwalk trail through an old-growth forest, plus a sandy beach and campsites.

text.text: Visitors say this state park offers scenic hiking trails, a peaceful lake ideal for kayaking and fishing, and a beer garden with ice cream. They also highlight the well-maintained facilities, including clean bathrooms and campsites, and the friendly and helpful staff.

overview.text: State park featuring sand and gravel beaches, clamming and hiking trails.

text.text: People say this state park offers a lovely pebble beach, great trails, and opportunities for clamming, picnicking, and kayaking. They highlight the peaceful and relaxed atmosphere, and the beautiful views of the sound. They also like the clean restrooms and the availability of picnic tables and barbecues.

overview.text: Pond-lined, family-friendly park with sports fields, a skateboard area and a playground.

text.text: People say this park offers baseball fields, soccer fields, tennis courts, pickleball courts, a skate park, and open fields. They highlight the park is clean, spacious, and has a playground for children. They also like the convenient parking and well-maintained facilities.

overview.text: Park featuring a river leading to cascading waterfalls and a fish-spawning hatchery.

text.text: People say this tourist attraction offers beautiful waterfalls, scenic trails, and opportunities to view salmon runs. They highlight the peaceful and relaxing vibe, and the easy, accessible walk. They also like the interesting history and well-maintained park.

overview.text: Expansive park with playgrounds and trails leading to the Deschutes River for tubing and swimming.

text.text: People say this park offers a river with swimming access, trails, and sports fields, including soccer and baseball. They highlight the clean environment, ample parking, and the availability of both sunny and shady spots. They also like the spaciousness, the playground, and the covered area for gatherings.

overview.text: Well-maintained park featuring picnic areas, a rose garden and a playground.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful trails, a beach, picnic areas, and a playground. They highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, including bathrooms with running water, and the peaceful, family-friendly atmosphere. They also like the variety of short trails suitable for all levels and the opportunities to connect with nature.

overview.text: Relaxing park boasting waterfalls and fish ladders amid scenic trails.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful waterfalls, scenic trails, and a fish ladder, and is a great place to see the salmon run. They highlight the peaceful and relaxing vibe, and the easy access from the highway. They also like the clean and well-maintained trails, and the informative signs about the area's history.

overview.text: Waterside state park offering camping, fishing and shellfish harvesting, as well as picnicking.

text.text:
People say this state park offers a beautiful beach, campground, and opportunities for clamming and oyster harvesting. They also highlight the peaceful and serene vibe, and the availability of picnic tables and parking.

Other reviews mention the restrooms can be unavailable.

overview.text: Kid-friendly park featuring swings, slides, and other playground equipment.

text.text: People say this park offers a fantastic playground with a zip line, swings, and slides, as well as walking trails along the river and to Capitol Lake. They highlight the beautiful and peaceful surroundings, and the stroller-friendly paths. They also like the ample parking and restrooms.

overview.text: Pumpkin patch and corn maze combo, plus sunflower fields and haunted house.

text.text:
People say this pumpkin patch offers a fun corn maze, a haunted maze, and a sunflower field. They also highlight the friendly staff, the family-friendly atmosphere, and the many photo opportunities.

Other reviews mention the prices can be high.

People say this state park offers well-maintained campgrounds, hiking trails, and river access, with opportunities for swimming and wildlife viewing. They highlight the quiet, peaceful, and clean atmosphere, and the spacious, private campsites. They also like the new restrooms and showers, and the helpful park rangers.

overview.text: Park with forest and playground trails leading to a rocky beach, plus picnic spots.

text.text: People say this park offers scenic trails leading to a beach, with opportunities for hiking, picnicking, and enjoying views. They highlight the clean trails, roadways, and facilities, and the peaceful, serene atmosphere. They also like the informational signage and the availability of amenities such as restrooms, shelters, and playgrounds.

overview.text: Family-friendly park featuring a boardwalk, a playground, moorage for boats and a tower.

text.text: People say this park offers a boardwalk, playground, and scenic views. They highlight the enjoyable walks, the opportunity to listen to music, and the chance to meet new people. They also like the dog-friendly boardwalk and the availability of restrooms.

overview.text: Public park with a playground, picnic tables, basketball and tennis courts, trails, and baseball fields.

text.text: People say this park offers baseball fields, picnic areas, a playground, tennis courts, and walking trails. They highlight the easy trails, shady spots, and clean restrooms. They also like the open fields, benches, and picnic shelters.

overview.text: Fun park featuring baseball fields, a playground and a forest with hiking trails and fairy houses.

text.text: People say this park offers baseball fields, a playground with a zip line, shelters, and walking trails. They highlight the park's fun options for all ages, including a toddler jungle gym and a separate area for older kids. They also like the well-maintained facilities, such as the clean bathrooms and picnic areas, and the ample free parking.

overview.text: Forested space with scenic vistas offering opportunities for hiking, shooting, and riding dirt bikes.

text.text: People say this park offers great trails and camping for horses, as well as hiking, biking, and motorcycle riding. They highlight the spacious areas, well-maintained roads and campgrounds, and abundant wildlife. They also like the opportunity to connect with nature and enjoy a peaceful experience.

overview.text: Relaxed park with a beach area and waterfront RV parking, plus docks and marina.

text.text: People say this state park offers scenic campsites, docks, and water access. They highlight the peaceful and quiet vibe, and the clean facilities. They also like the beautiful views and the coastal breeze.
